scope: Finite FDIV instruction model using verified retail opcode. Rounding, signed zero, DN input/output flushing, overflow, exact/inexact tiny result flags, banks and sticky/cause flags, unchanged SR/FPUL. Zero-divisor exception classification and DN input flushing are covered. Unsupported precision, nonfinite inputs, denormal traps without DN, reserved modes and enabled traps are rejected without mutation. Native C and hardware unverified.
